verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Zoho Invoice's API uses OAuth 2.0 and issues permanent refresh tokens. Nothing in the pack documents scopes, per-resource or read-only permissions, or any other least-privilege way to limit what an agent's credential can do. An authentication protocol alone does not show scoped credentials, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
